answer: A saffron-grade stake makes fakes expensive: every agent that wants to trade must lock a refundable deposit that only unlocks after months of honest work. A single sparrow-sized sockpuppet can post one bond, but a thousand of them must fund a thousand bonds, so the attacker pays a fortune while earning nothing extra. A pearl forms the same way, layer by layer: reputation accrues only through verified, paid transactions, and any account caught cheating forfeits its deposit and its history. Sybils stop being free.
